_schema.note: Curated app manifest. scripts/build.mjs compiles each app to public/apps/<id>/<artifact>; scripts/generate.mjs emits one loader page per entry. Adding an app = source (or submodule) + an entry here + rebuild.

fields.id: url-safe slug; also the public/apps/<id>/ directory
fields.name: display label on the gallery card
fields.source: 'local' (compile sourceDir with our javac) | 'submodule' (run build cmd) | 'prebuilt' (copy apps/<id>/<artifact>, a jar built once from an upstream repo)
fields.sourceDir: for source=local: dir of .java files to compile (relative to repo root)
fields.mainClass: Main-Class written into the jar manifest (source=local)
fields.artifact: output jar filename under public/apps/<id>/ (for source=prebuilt, also the committed jar under apps/<id>/)
fields.javaTarget: javac --release level; build fails if > 17 (CheerpJ ceiling)
fields.cheerpjVersion: 8 | 11 | 17 — the runtime the loader inits for this app
fields.display: { w, h } CheerpJ display size in px
fields.relay: optional true — app bundles the javalabrelay client; loader registers cheerpj-shim.js natives, sets javalab.browser=true, and passes --browser (pair/fetch over wss://javalab.dconn.dev/relay)
fields.thumbnail: image filename (relative to the app dir) copied to public/apps/<id>/
fields.webNotes: porting caveats (see each app's WEB_NOTES.md; do not revert)

apps.name: Javarominoes
apps.description: Tetris-inspired block-stacking puzzle game built with Java Swing.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/javarominoes (NetBeans Ant, Java 8). Jar bundles the chiptune-synth engine (chiptunesynth.*); the song classes (Korobeiniki, Wily, DuckTales Moon, Hyrule Temple, ...) live in javarominoes/model/music. MIDI playback was dropped — all music is synthesized, so audio needs the Java-8 runtime. Native 1280x720; the stage scales it to fit.

apps.name: Seas of Yore
apps.description: A medieval Battleship-inspired board game with custom sprites and modes.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/seas-of-yore (NetBeans Ant, Java 8). Bundles the javalabrelay client; online multiplayer (host/join a room code) runs over wss://javalab.dconn.dev/relay via the cheerpj-shim.js WebSocket natives + javalab.browser=true. Image assets live at the jar root under images/. ~6 MB jar — most of it is the title art.

apps.name: Draw Shapes
apps.description: Lightweight drawing program: shapes, colors, brush sizes, undo, load/save.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/draw-shapes (NetBeans Ant, Java 8). Toolbar icons load from images/ at the jar root. Save/Load use the CheerpJ virtual filesystem, not the host disk.

apps.name: ChiptuneSynth
apps.description: NES 2A03-style chiptune player — pick a track and play; pulse/triangle/noise + percussion.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/chiptune-synth. Operator-supplied prebuilt jar running chiptunesynth.player.ChiptunePlayer — the dedicated runner with the full song library (Korobeiniki, Wily, DuckTales Moon, Hyrule Temple, Contra Jungle, Flashman, Bloody Tears, Surf City). Native window 380x420. Audio via javax.sound.sampled — CheerpJ supports this on Java 8 only. (Replaced the earlier ChiptuneDemo launcher.)

apps.name: Ten-Color Chooser
apps.description: Swing color workbench: ten rows with pickers, darken/brighten, live hex.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/ten-color-chooser (Maven layout, src/main/java, release 8). Compiled with our javac; pure JDK, no external deps.

apps.name: Stopwatch
apps.description: Swing stopwatch with min:sec:msec display, pause/resume, and reset.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/stopwatch (NetBeans Ant, Java 8). Pure Swing; runs as-is.

apps.name: Guess
apps.description: Swing number-guessing game (1-1000) with styled feedback and validation.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/guess (NetBeans Ant, Java 8). Pure Swing; runs as-is.

apps.name: Site Selector
apps.description: A very lightweight web browser written in Java Swing.
apps.webNotes: From github.com/dylantcon/site-selector (NetBeans Ant, Java 8). Bundles the javalabrelay client; when run with javalab.browser=true it fetches pages through the relay's guarded GET proxy (FETCH over wss://javalab.dconn.dev/relay) instead of a direct cross-origin request, so remote sites load.

apps.name: Triangles
apps.description: A Swing animation of drifting, colorful triangles.
apps.webNotes: Operator-supplied prebuilt jar (default-package Triangles); Main-Class stamped at install. Pure Swing, Java 8.

apps.name: Screen Saver
apps.description: A screensaver that paints a field of random colorful ellipses.
apps.webNotes: Operator-supplied prebuilt jar (default-package ScreenSaver); Main-Class stamped at install. Pure Swing, Java 8.

apps.name: Snowman
apps.description: A little Swing winter scene with a snowman.
apps.webNotes: Operator-supplied prebuilt jar (default-package Snowman); Main-Class stamped at install. Pure Swing, Java 8.
